name: Vanessa Haro
office: City of Commerce, Member of the City Council

items.text: Vanessa Haro is a candidate for the City of Commerce City Council. She says one of her biggest priorities is creating a cleaner, greener, healthy environment for the community. She supports emergency preparedness for industrial facility accidents, increased tree canopy and parks, and expanded affordable housing options to protect against high heat.
